# Load libraries

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(here)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
```

# Load data

Set paths to data directory and output directory
```{r}
data_path = "path/to/data"

output_path  = "path/to/output_dir"
```

```{r}
esviritu_res <- fread(paste0(data_path, "Esviritu_HostDiseaseGenometypeV5.tsv"))

esviritu_res_human <- esviritu_res %>% 
  filter(host_species == "Homo sapiens")

sample_metadata <- read.csv(paste0(data_path, "samples_metadata.csv"), sep=";", dec=",")
```



# Plot pie charts for accession count and RPKMF values distribution by host

Create a color palette to use:
```{r}
cat_colors <- c("Sus" = "#3E8C6E",
            "Others" = "#F4A261",
            "Homo" = "#7B71B6",
            "Gallus" = "#06D6A0",
            "Bos" = "#EF476F",
            "unknown" = "#264653",
            "Canis" = "#E06666",
            "Felis" = "#FFD166",
            "Hipposideros" = "#F77F00",
            "Culex" = "#118AB2",
            "Cucurbita" = "#D62828",
            "Capsicum" = "#8ECAE6",
            "Columba" = "#FFB5A7",
            "Rattus" = "#2A9D8F",
            "Equus" = "#90BE6D",

            "Enteric" = "#7B71B6",
            "Hematotropic"= "#FFD166",
            "Mucocutaneous" = "#3E8C6E",

            "Systemic" = "#EF476F",
            "Unknown" = "#E06666",
            "Urinary/Renal" = "#06D6A0")
```


## RPKMF & species count - pie chart

```{r functions-for-pie-charts}
summarize_tax_levels <- function(data, col, taxa_level){
  data %>%
    group_by(!!sym(col)) %>%
    summarize(phylums=n_distinct(phylum),
              classes=n_distinct(tclass),
              orders=n_distinct(order),
              families=n_distinct(family),
              genera=n_distinct(genus),
              species=n_distinct(species),
              subspecies=n_distinct(subspecies),
              Accession=n_distinct(accession),
              .groups="drop") %>%
    mutate(total_value=!!sym(taxa_level)) %>%
    rename(category=!!sym(col)) %>%
    arrange(desc(total_value)) %>%
    mutate(category = ifelse(row_number() > 11 | category=="", "Others", category)) %>%
    group_by(category) %>%
    summarize(total_value=sum(total_value), .groups="drop") %>%
    mutate(proportion = 100 * total_value / sum(total_value),
         label =paste0(category, " (", round(total_value,2), " - ",
                        round(proportion, 1),"%)")) %>%
    arrange(desc(total_value))
  
}

sum_cat_top10 <- function(data, col, val){
  data %>%
    group_by(!!sym(col)) %>%
    summarize(total_value=sum(!!sym(val)), .groups="drop") %>%
    rename(category = !!sym(col)) %>%
    arrange(desc(total_value)) %>%
    mutate(category = ifelse(row_number() > 10 | category=="", "Others", category)) %>%
    group_by(category) %>%
    summarise(total_value = sum(total_value), .groups = "drop")%>% 
    mutate(proportion = 100 * total_value / sum(total_value),
         label =paste0(category, " (", round(total_value,2), " - ",
                        round(proportion, 1),"%)"),
         category=category) %>%
    arrange(desc(total_value))
  
}

host_pie <- function(data){
  n_cat <- length(unique(data$category))
  data$label <- factor(data$label, levels = data$label)
  data$category <- factor(data$category, levels = data$category[order(data$label)])

  data %>%
  ggplot(data=., aes(x="", y=total_value, fill=category)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity", width=0.1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=cat_colors,
                    labels = data$label,
                    name="", 
                    drop=FALSE) +
  coord_polar("y", start=0) +
    theme_void() +
  theme(legend.key.size = unit(1.1, "lines"),
        legend.text = element_text(size=14), 
        plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)) 
}
```

Plot pie plots for host genera distribution - whole data

```{r}
accession_pie_genus <- host_pie(summarize_tax_levels(esviritu_res, "host_genus", "Accession"))
accession_pie_genus

RPKMF_pie_genus <- host_pie(sum_cat_top10(esviritu_res, "host_genus", "true_rpkmf"))
RPKMF_pie_genus

ggsave(accession_pie_genus, 
       file = paste0(output_path, "Figures/Accession_pie_genus.jpg"), 
       width = 7.2, height = 4.5, units = "in", dpi=300)
 
ggsave(RPKMF_pie_genus, 
       file = paste0(output_path, "Figures/RPKMF_pie_genus.jpg"), 
       width = 7.2, height = 4.5, units = "in", dpi=300)
```
Sanity check to see if the legend is right:
```{r}
esviritu_res %>%
  filter(host_genus=="Homo") %>%
  summarize(accessions=n_distinct(accession))

esviritu_res %>%
  filter(host_genus=="Homo") %>%
  summarize(RPKMF_sum=sum(true_rpkmf))
```

## Plot pie plots for human data, distribtuion of tropism based on 
accession counts and RPKMF values - divided by years

```{r}
samples_20_21 <- sample_metadata %>%
  filter(Year_cat=="2020-2021") %>%
  pull(sample_ID)

samples_24_25 <- sample_metadata %>%
  filter(Year_cat=="2024-2025") %>%
  pull(sample_ID)

esviritu_res_human_20_21 <- esviritu_res_human %>%
  filter(sample_id %in% samples_20_21)

esviritu_res_human_24_25 <- esviritu_res_human %>%
  filter(sample_id %in% samples_24_25)
```

Plot accession count pieplots of tropism distributions
```{r}
# 2020-2021
accession_pie_tropism_20_21 <- host_pie(summarize_tax_levels(esviritu_res_human_20_21, 
                                                             "tropism_broad", "Accession"))
accession_pie_tropism_20_21

ggsave(accession_pie_tropism_20_21, 
       file = paste0(output_path, "Figures/accession_pie_tropism_20_21.jpg"), 
       width = 7.2, height = 4.5, units = "in", dpi=300)

# 2024-2025
accession_pie_tropism_24_25 <- host_pie(summarize_tax_levels(esviritu_res_human_24_25, 
                                                             "tropism_broad", "Accession"))
accession_pie_tropism_24_25

ggsave(accession_pie_tropism_24_25, 
       file = paste0(output_path, "Figures/accession_pie_tropism_24_25.jpg"), 
       width = 7.2, height = 4.5, units = "in", dpi=300)
```

Check for legend:
```{r}
esviritu_res_human_24_25 %>%
  filter(host_species=="Homo sapiens",
         tropism_broad=="Enteric") %>%
  summarize(accessions=n_distinct(accession))
```
Plot RPKMF sum pieplots of tropism distributions

```{r}

RPKMF_pie_tropism_20_21 <- host_pie(sum_cat_top10(esviritu_res_human_20_21, 
                                                  "tropism_broad", "true_rpkmf"))
RPKMF_pie_tropism_20_21

ggsave(RPKMF_pie_tropism_20_21, 
       file = paste0(output_path, "Figures/RPKMF_pie_tropism_20_21.jpg"),

# 2024-2025
RPKMF_pie_tropism_24_25 <- host_pie(sum_cat_top10(esviritu_res_human_24_25,
```
